design.name: Frozen 2026 temporal validation
design.method_selection: minimum common-support selection-period SST RMSE separately per horizon; exact ties use candidate_order
design.scope: New, previously unexamined temporal targets in the same NOAA OISST product, not an independent observational source or a prospective live forecast. Researcher has already examined 2010-2025 exploratory results. Only frozen selected methods and the baseline will be scored; no model re-selection or re-calibration on 2026. January-August is an incomplete annual cycle.

ridge_harmonic_trend.penalty_definition: mean squared training error + alpha * sum(standardized lag coefficients squared); intercept unpenalized

harmonic.scope: training OLS; linear extrapolation is an assumption, not an estimate of future warming

harmonic_trend.scope: training OLS; linear extrapolation is an assumption, not an estimate of future warming

1/ridge_harmonic_trend.scope: held-out empirical absolute-error radius; dependent data, no guaranteed coverage

1/persistence.scope: held-out empirical absolute-error radius; dependent data, no guaranteed coverage

7/ar_harmonic_trend.scope: held-out empirical absolute-error radius; dependent data, no guaranteed coverage

7/persistence.scope: held-out empirical absolute-error radius; dependent data, no guaranteed coverage

30/ar_harmonic_trend.scope: held-out empirical absolute-error radius; dependent data, no guaranteed coverage

30/persistence.scope: held-out empirical absolute-error radius; dependent data, no guaranteed coverage

fitting_rule: training coefficients remain fixed; internal hyperparameters use selection-period 7-day RMSE; overall method uses selection-period RMSE separately at each horizon
support_rule: all eight candidates share selection/calibration targets; only selected method and baseline share new test targets at each horizon

boundary.product: IHO Sea Areas, version 3 (2018), WFS iho layer
boundary.name: Yellow Sea
boundary.citation: Flanders Marine Institute (2018). IHO Sea Areas, version 3.
boundary.mask_rule: grid center covered by polygon; intersect first-day valid OISST cells
boundary.distribution: download from provider; boundary data not committed or redistributed

provenance.previously_seen: 2010-2025 exploratory study, including its retrospective test comparisons
